title: Chapter 3 — The Core
description: The final chapter, plus a pass over what the monsters do and what they sound like. The hoist now actually takes hold of you, Chapter 3's hunters are no longer invisible in their own fights, and nothing switches off while you are looking at it. The voice has been rebuilt from the ground up.
changelog: Fixed: the hoist claws could not reach the floor, so the grab looked like floating — they now close on you and carry you up and down
Fixed: Chapter 3's hunters spent both set-pieces fifteen metres up on the ceiling, invisible, still swinging
Fixed: monsters no longer blink out of existence in front of you — in the lift, the hoist bay, the duct or the last fight, they leave
New monster voice: an intake, a fundamental that collapses from 118 Hz, detuned partials and a sub you feel. No more held vowel.
The growl and the jumpscare hit rebuilt to match — the sting is an impact now, not a violin shriek
Roars are pitched differently every time and come less often, so a chase stops sounding like a metronome
Chapter 3 — The Core: 101 rooms, two subfloors, and the end of it
The extendable hand: bars pull you up, shutters come down, jammed doors come apart, crates drag across a floor
Every wall sign removed from all three chapters — claw marks and drag trails instead
New menu: a corridor that recedes into the dark, and something at the end of it that looks back
notes: A signed release build, not a debug one. Installs over any earlier build and keeps every world; every release is signed with the same key so updates never need an uninstall.
